# Find The Professional Journey Section In Figma

#### Course: Figma to Code

## Find The Professional Journey Section In Figma

Scroll down in Figma until you reach the section titled Professional Journey.

![Find the Professional Journey](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

You should see:

- A section title with a short intro line
- Multiple experience entries stacked vertically
- Each entry follows the same layout
- Date on the left
- Content on the right
- Tags at the bottom

Before you write any HTML, take a moment to notice what repeats and what changes between entries. That's what should guide your structure.

And remember this: sections with repeated content are where layout mistakes show up most. Get one entry right first, then repeat it.
